content.formula: Bloom 1 + Grave 1 | Restoration > Conjuration > Alteration | Th2 Tu3 Kn4 Sp4 Ho4 Fi4 Ag4 Co4 | Carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.
content.purpose: Returns a destroyed or dispersed nation toward viable peoplehood through land recovery, language, institutions, ancestry, food, ritual, and new living adaptation.
content.practice: Survivors, descendants, present inhabitants, neighbours, the anonymous dead, and future citizens hold separate definitions of return.
content.consequence: Old claims and diseases reappear, present lives are displaced, donor fertility is consumed, and national identity becomes biologically potent.
content.failure: The Wonder recreates the regime that caused ruin, treats descendants as copies, or expels current inhabitants to restore a sacred picture.
content.safeShedding: Reduce the number of subjects before relaxing the definition of a safe state.
content.counterplay: Contest the reference nation, invoke present rights, preserve ruins, introduce new citizenship, or refuse ancestral form.
content.mastery: A master resurrects capacity for self-definition, not a corpse of history, and accepts a country that returns unrecognisable.

title: Parliament of the Living and Dead
description: Creates a national assembly of living communities, species, ancestors, extinct lineages, future generations, and ecological successors through bounded representatives.

facts.carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.

provenance.location: Bloom + Grave: The Living Cycle / Wonders / L48

content.formula: Bloom 1 + Grave 1 | Conjuration > Divination > Enchantment | Th2 Tu3 Kn4 Sp4 Ho4 Fi4 Ag4 Co4 | Carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.
content.purpose: Creates a national assembly of living communities, species, ancestors, extinct lineages, future generations, and ecological successors through bounded representatives.
content.practice: No representative may claim a whole category; silence, contradiction, expiry, and the living veto over coercive dead claims are constitutional.
content.consequence: Politics becomes biologically and ancestrally entangled, representation changes evolution, and the dead gain durable presence.
content.failure: Ancestors rule descendants, charismatic species dominate, future people are invented, or institutions breed agreeable representatives.
content.safeShedding: Collapse Agency into a simple path, then dismiss the shape cleanly.
content.counterplay: Challenge a seat, invoke silence, expose change, dissolve a representative, or refuse translation.
content.mastery: A master protects the unrepresented and keeps every voice advisory enough that life remains free to surprise government.

title: The Great Cycle Engine
description: Links national food, waste, burial, soil, forestry, urban renewal, disease control, and ecological restoration into one vast circulation of matter and ending.

facts.carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.

provenance.location: Bloom + Grave: The Living Cycle / Wonders / L49

content.formula: Bloom 1 + Grave 1 | Enchantment > Alteration > Restoration > Abjuration | Th2 Tu4 Kn4 Sp4 Ho4 Fi4 Ag4 Co4 | Carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.
content.purpose: Links national food, waste, burial, soil, forestry, urban renewal, disease control, and ecological restoration into one vast circulation of matter and ending.
content.practice: Regions retain isolation, sacred remains, manual alternatives, ecological limits, refusal, and authority to waste rather than recycle.
content.consequence: Efficiency becomes dependency, disease and policy travel, local difference shrinks, and people risk being treated as material flows.
content.failure: The Engine consumes what society still values, makes poverty into feedstock, or restores the same hierarchy each cycle.
content.safeShedding: Enter a stable idle state and release Span before an anchor begins storing uncontrolled debt.
content.counterplay: Invoke isolation, protect waste, break a flow, introduce novelty, preserve a ruin, or withdraw regional consent.
content.mastery: Sovereign mastery keeps loss, gift, excess, and irreversibility outside the machine, accepting waste so the nation never becomes perfectly edible.

title: The Wheel That Turns Once
description: Allows a nation, ecosystem, or civilisation to pass through one sovereign death and rebirth, ending an age and releasing an unprecedented living order from its remains.

facts.carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.

provenance.location: Bloom + Grave: The Living Cycle / Wonders / L50

content.formula: Bloom 2 + Grave 2 | Restoration > Evocation > Conjuration | Th2 Tu3 Kn4 Sp4 Ho4 Fi4 Ag4 Co4 | Carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.
content.purpose: Allows a nation, ecosystem, or civilisation to pass through one sovereign death and rebirth, ending an age and releasing an unprecedented living order from its remains.
content.practice: No conductor controls both ending and return; survivors, the dead, neighbours, dissenters, and unknown future life hold independent vetoes and refuges.
content.consequence: Identity, climate, species, law, memory, and fertility are rewritten; what returns may not recognise what paid for it.
content.failure: The Wheel repeats, resurrects an idealised past, consumes protected survivors, or makes novelty into a destiny no living person chose.
content.safeShedding: End spectacle, symbolism, and audience effects before loosening safety Knots.
content.counterplay: Break either half of the rite, preserve an untaken refuge, contest continuity, deny the return name, or let the age end without rebirth.
content.mastery: The supreme practitioner keeps the Wheel capable of stopping after death, accepts a future without the old nation's name, and never turns twice.
content.sourceMeta: WONDERS | CULTURE AND ANOMALY | LOAD 29 | PROOF RECONCILIATION + UNWEAVING | SUCCESSION LENS
